description: Sample name (from HP_IN); rows are one per (sample, SV event).
Contig name (chrM / rCRS); circular mtDNA, 16569 bp.
SV type. DEL is default; DUP/INV are opt-in (HP_SV_DUP / HP_SV_INV).
5' breakpoint: last retained base before the event (VCF POS).
3' breakpoint: last deleted base for DEL (VCF END). MitoBreak's 3' bp = end_bp3+1.
Event length in bp (the VCF SVLEN is signed: negative for DEL).
PASS evidence path: DJ = coverage-drop and junction agree; J = junction-strong alone.
Junction-supporting split reads.
Wild-type reads spanning the breakpoints (denominator of AFJ).
Junction VAF (AFJ) = jr / (jr + sr).
Coverage-dosage VAF (AFC) = 1 - inside/flank depth; PRIMARY heteroplasmy. '.' for INV.
|AFC - AFJ|: agreement QC between the two heteroplasmy estimates.
Masked coverage ratio inside/flank (the basis of AFC).
Trimmed-median flanking read depth.
Breakpoint microhomology / direct-repeat length (bp).
Microhomology/direct-repeat sequence; empty when homlen=0.
Breakpoint-homology class: I=perfect repeat >=5 bp, II=1-4 bp microhomology, III=blunt. '.' if not DEL.
1 if the call matches the common deletion del4977 (m.8470_13447) within tolerance.
Number of genes/features the event overlaps.
Comma-joined overlapped gene/feature names, or '.'.
HGVS-style description, e.g. NC_012920.1:m.8483_13446del.
VCF FILTER: PASS, or ';'-joined non-PASS reasons (lowJR, no_cvg_drop, low_dosage, lowAFJ, WRAP, ...).
FP-control flags (REPEAT, NUMT, HP, DLOOP, WRAP, INVDUP, ...), comma-joined or '.'; annotate (mostly non-rejecting).
Split-read size consistency (microhomology-invariant).
Split-read strand balance.
Split-read evidence tier (depth-independent).
Per-call confidence (higher = more likely a true event); '.' for WRAP/origin calls.
Biological-impact score (gene/origin/constraint weighted).
Impact band label (e.g. SEVERE / MODERATE / ...).

[COHORT-ONLY] Closest matching MitoBreak previously-reported breakpoint id (DEL_bp5_bp3 / DUP_bp5_bp3) within HP_SV_MITOBREAK_TOL bp, or '.'. Added by getSVSummary.sh/svMitoBreak.py; NOT present in per-sample $O.sv.tab.
